def main(argv=None):
    # `--workspace` is accepted on either side of the subcommand: the contracts write it
    # after (`... submit --workspace <project> <script>`), a shell habit writes it before.
    common = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    common.add_argument("--workspace", default=argparse.SUPPRESS,
                        help="the project directory that owns _config/")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="The workspace's batch executor (0039).",
                                     parents=[common])
    parser.set_defaults(workspace=".")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p_header = sub.add_parser("header", parents=[common],
                              help="print the generated submit.sh directives block")
    p_header.add_argument("--project", default="{project}")
    p_header.add_argument("--assay", default="{assay}")
    p_header.add_argument("--substage", default=".")
    for key in ("partition", "time", "cpus", "mem"):
        p_header.add_argument("--" + key, default=None)

    p_submit = sub.add_parser("submit", parents=[common],
                              help="submit a GENERATED submit.sh")
    p_submit.add_argument("script")

    p_status = sub.add_parser("status", parents=[common],
                              help="the state of a submitted job")
    p_status.add_argument("job_id")

    sub.add_parser("describe", parents=[common],
                   help="the resolved descriptor and any problems with it")

    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.command:
        parser.print_help()
        return EXIT_USAGE

    root = Path(args.workspace)
    descriptor = load(root)
    problems = validate(descriptor)
    result = {"command": args.command, "executor": descriptor.get("name"),
              "descriptor": str(descriptor_path(root)),
              "descriptor_present": descriptor_path(root).is_file()}

    if args.command == "describe":
        result["resolved"] = descriptor
        result["problems"] = problems
        result["ok"] = not problems
        return emit(result, EXIT_OK if not problems else EXIT_REFUSED)

    if problems:
        result["problems"] = problems
        return emit(result, EXIT_REFUSED)

    if args.command == "header":
        cfg = {}
        for key in ("partition", "time", "cpus", "mem"):
            value = getattr(args, key)
            if value:
                cfg["compute." + key] = value
        result["header"] = header_lines(root, cfg, args.project, args.assay, args.substage,
                                        descriptor=descriptor)
        return emit(result, EXIT_OK)

    if args.command == "submit":
        job_id, detail = submit(root, args.script, descriptor=descriptor)
        if job_id is None:
            result["error"] = detail
            return emit(result, EXIT_FAILURE)
        result["job_id"] = job_id
        result["ok"] = True
        return emit(result, EXIT_OK)

    if args.command == "status":
        state, detail = status(root, args.job_id, descriptor=descriptor)
        if state is None:
            result["error"] = detail
            return emit(result, EXIT_FAILURE)
        result["job_id"] = args.job_id
        result["state"] = state
        result["terminal"] = state in ("COMPLETED", "FAILED")
        return emit(result, EXIT_OK)

    return EXIT_USAGE


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""sample-pca: PCA of samples from gene-level counts, coloured by condition (see ../PLAN.md)."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

ASSAY = "rnaseq_bulk"
TOP_N = 500

analysis = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()   # .../03_custom_analysis/01_sample-pca
workspace = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()  # gars/
project = analysis.parent.parent
results = analysis / "results"
results.mkdir(exist_ok=True)


def resolve(artifact_type):
    out = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(workspace / "_system" / "resolve_artifact.py"),
         "--project", str(project), "--assay", ASSAY, "--type", artifact_type],
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    entry = json.loads(out)["resolved"][artifact_type]
    return project / entry["resolved"]


counts_path = resolve("counts_gene")
design_path = resolve("design")

# 1. load
counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, sep="\t", index_col="gene_id").drop(columns="gene_name")
design = pd.read_csv(design_path)
if set(design["sample_id"]) != set(counts.columns):
    sys.exit(f"design sample_id {sorted(design['sample_id'])} != count columns {sorted(counts.columns)}")
design = design.set_index("sample_id").loc[counts.columns]

# 2. drop all-zero genes
counts = counts.loc[(counts > 0).any(axis=1)]
print(f"genes after dropping all-zero: {len(counts)}")

# 3. log2(x + 1)
logc = np.log2(counts + 1)

# 4. top-variable genes (all, if fewer than TOP_N)
if len(logc) > TOP_N:
    logc = logc.loc[logc.var(axis=1).nlargest(TOP_N).index]
print(f"genes used for PCA: {len(logc)}")

# 5. centre per gene, no scaling; samples are rows
x = logc.T.values
x = x - x.mean(axis=0)

# 6. PCA
n_comp = min(x.shape)
pca = PCA(n_components=n_comp)
scores = pca.fit_transform(x)
pcs = [f"PC{i + 1}" for i in range(n_comp)]
var = pca.explained_variance_ratio_

# 8. tables
scores_df = pd.concat(
    [design.reset_index(), pd.DataFrame(scores, columns=pcs)], axis=1)
scores_df.to_csv(results / "pca_scores.csv", index=False)
pd.DataFrame({"PC": pcs, "proportion_variance": var,
              "cumulative": np.cumsum(var)}).to_csv(results / "pca_variance.csv", index=False)

# 7. plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
conditions = list(dict.fromkeys(design["condition"]))
colours = ["#1f77b4", "#d95f02", "#1b9e77", "#7570b3"]
for cond, colour in zip(conditions, colours):
    mask = (scores_df["condition"] == cond).values
    ax.scatter(scores[mask, 0], scores[mask, 1], s=60, color=colour, label=cond)
for sid, px, py in zip(scores_df["sample_id"], scores[:, 0], scores[:, 1]):
    ax.annotate(sid, (px, py), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(6, 6), fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel(f"PC1 ({var[0] * 100:.1f}% variance)")
ax.set_ylabel(f"PC2 ({var[1] * 100:.1f}% variance)")
ax.axhline(0, color="0.85", lw=0.8, zorder=0)
ax.axvline(0, color="0.85", lw=0.8, zorder=0)
ax.legend(title="condition", frameon=False)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(results / "pca_plot.png", dpi=300)
fig.savefig(results / "pca_plot.svg")
print("done")
